page.overview:
Who is Cora?

Cora was a Human female Corellian Security Force officer who lived on Corellia during the Galactic Civil War.

Following the Battle of Yavin, Cora was an inspector of the Corellian Security Force, stationed in Tyrena,

In 1 ABY, a ship piloted by CorSec Captain Donovan and carrying a cargo of weapons to the local CorSec force in Tyrena apparently crashed near the city. Cora was ordered by Captain Jark to investigate the crash.

Inspector Cora therefore ordered the spacer to return to the Deflarian camp were the spacer found Sinis' medical equipment. From a scan of the area, Cora identified a courier who was used by the Deflarians for deliveries between camps. The spacer followed the courier until they arrived to the Deflarian bunker. The spacer infiltrated the bunker and found the imprisoned Captain Donovan. The spacer therefore killed Vinros, several Deflarian henchmen and a Deflarian underboss to liberate Donovan.
